description:
Because:

- 123done uses Express 4 res.send(status, body) forms that Express 5 removes.

This commit:

- Upgrades express to ^5.2.1 in 123done and updates yarn.lock.
- Uses res.status(n).send() and res.sendStatus() for status responses.
- Falls back to {} when req.body is undefined in the webhook and todo save routes.

Closes FXA-14785
